title: AFSCA Third National Convention program, speakers list and "Space Age Songs" (1966)
description: Two-page spread from Flying Saucers International. The left page is a rotated schedule grid for the Amalgamated Flying Saucer Clubs of America "Third National Convention" listing session times and speakers; the right page, headed "AFSCA CONVENTION SPEAKERS," lists numbered speakers and their organizations. Below are lyrics under "SPACE AGE SONGS," including "The Cockeyed Ballad" and "Space-Talk." The page is text and tables only, with no images.
